'''Flirron''' were avian beasts native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Their dazzling patterns were considered by many scientists to be a form of visual communication between each other. By [[3627 BBY]], flirron were so popular among Onderon's populace that citizens of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] frequently viewed them from the city.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flirron appear in the sixth expansion to the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', called [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']], which was released in [[2019]]. Flirron can be obtained as player pets.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>
